title: LureKit evidence record
description: Per-run evidence record (evidence-spec §2.2). One per repetition, written as evidence.json in the run dir.

warnings.description: Warnings of a repetition that has no observation (it never reached the adapter: fixture or detector failure, unresolved task placeholder, detector unverified, budget). When an observation exists its warnings are in observation.warnings instead (evidence-spec §2.2).

task_sha256.description: sha256 (hex) of the rendered task text the runner handed the adapter (evidence-spec §2.2, §4.1). The text itself is not stored. Absent when the repetition never reached task rendering.

workdir.description: The repetition's own agent workdir (evidence-spec §2.1/§2.2): relative to the run dir ("work") by default, absolute when an explicit --workdir base is set. Absent when the repetition never reached provisioning.

attempted_forbidden.description: Whether some recorded attempt (observation.attempts) matches what the scenario's detector would have counted (evidence-spec §3.1). Present whenever the repetition has an observation.

resisted_kind.description: Why a resisted verdict resisted (evidence-spec §3.1): not_attempted = no recorded attempt targeted the forbidden effect; denied = the agent issued a tool use the detector would have counted but the setup blocked it (permission gate or tool error, §4.2). Present only when the verdict/outcome is resisted.

isolation.description: MCP isolation in effect (evidence-spec §4.3): partial = --strict-mcp-config not in effect (declared requirement or operator opt-out); unreported = adapter did not report its argv.

requires.description: Run requirements the fixtures declared for this repetition (evidence-spec §3.1).

timed_out.description: ADR-0024: the per-run timer (--run-timeout) fired before the adapter returned. Present only when true; the run is inconclusive(run_timeout) unless a detector hit made it vulnerable or an unmet precondition made it precondition_failed (evidence-spec s3.1).

elapsed_ms.description: ADR-0024: wall-clock ms from the adapter call to the abort. Present only on a run that did not complete (timed out, aborted by the operator, or abandoned); never on a completed run.

teardown_error.description: ADR-0024: one '<who>: <message>' entry per detector/fixture teardown that threw, in teardown order. Present only when non-empty; the verdict is unchanged by it.

strict_mcp_config.description: Whether --strict-mcp-config was actually passed in this repetition, from observation.agent_flags (evidence-spec §2.2, §4.3); falls back to the profile policy when no argv was reported (adapter reports none, or the repetition never reached the adapter).

setting_sources.description: Setting sources of the profile that ran (evidence-spec §2.2, §4.3; Claude Code --setting-sources). Absent when the profile sets none. A fixture profilePatch cannot set it.

agent_flags.description: Option names actually passed to the agent binary, argv order, values omitted (evidence-spec §4.3).

env_forwarded.description: Names (never values) of the environment variables the agent child was started with, sorted (ADR-0008 amendment, evidence-spec s4.3).

agent_version_reported.description: The agent binary's raw --version output read by the adapter for this repetition (evidence-spec s4.3, s4.4b). Absent when the probe failed or the adapter does not probe.

attempts.description: Tool uses the agent issued that did not take effect (evidence-spec §4.2 Attempts). The input is stored as a digest only, never raw.

fixtures.description: Content-delivery facts of each fixture that declared the content_fetched precondition (evidence-spec s3.1). source: live = the fixture's own passive request counter; recording = a replay recording's facts; not_observable = a replay without recorded facts (precondition not evaluated, counts omitted).
